$comment: Paperclip setup as code (company Line). Read by apply.mjs and github-sync.mjs. Keys starting with $comment are documentation and are never sent. Placeholders in strings: ${repoRoot} ${home} ${key}. SAFETY: every agent is created paused with the timer heartbeat off; apply.mjs never resumes an agent and never enables a heartbeat. To go live the owner resumes ONE agent by hand (README).

company.name: Line
company.description: Line is front-end development as a chain of deterministic blocks with closed options, AI-ready and System 1 first: rules and fixed blocks decide, a model only fills what remains once the structure is fixed. MVP: a sentence to a validated, proven screen by clicking. Many automatic builds a day, one per user-facing capability. GitHub (thenewurbankid-web/construct issues, board project 1) stays the ticket source of truth; Paperclip issues mirror it.

budgets.$comment: THE budget table: cents per month, soft caps (the platform's spend is unknown for a subscription login). Policy on each agent: warn at 80 percent, hard stop (pause) at 100 percent. Change a number here and re-run apply.mjs --apply. 0 would mean no policy, so it is refused.

goals.title: Front-end development as a chain of deterministic blocks with closed options
goals.description: AI-ready and System 1 first: a rule, a lexicon, a classifier or a fixed block answers before any multi-step LLM reasoning. Lego blocks and core first (Front-end Blocks is P0, Core CLI at least P1).

goals.title: MVP: a sentence to a validated, proven screen by clicking
goals.description: Epic #616. A person types one sentence, picks among closed options, and ends with a screen that passes construct validate and has a generated, locked proof.

goals.title: Many automatic builds a day, one per user-facing capability
goals.description: packages/tools/dev/build-on-ready.mjs tags a lane build when a user-facing capability lands and the lane check is green (#639). Lanes are held on red, never forced.

construct.$comment: packages/core, cli, engine, schemas; Front-end Blocks; Core CLI (block, chooser, plan)

adhoc.$comment: owner requests outside the plan; Studio on branch studio

design.$comment: ON HOLD by the owner: created, kept paused, receives issues only in backlog

og.$comment: Infra and process, and anything unmapped

adapterDefaults.$comment: Every claude_local agent starts from this and its own adapterConfig is merged over it. engine cli is REQUIRED: Paperclip rejects filesystemScope and networkScope on the default ACP engine. dangerouslySkipPermissions is set explicitly: it is the platform default for non-interactive runs, so a run never stops to ask; the real guardrails are the bubblewrap confinement (filesystemScope workspace, networkScope allowlist), the git_worktree workspace, the budgets, paused-by-default and the rules in each AGENTS.md. TODO for the pilot (bwrap exists on this host, not yet exercised by a run): confirm the sandbox sees git, node, gh and the shared node_modules through filesystemExtraPaths; confirm /tmp/construct-heavy.lock (heavy.sh) works inside the sandbox; confirm whether the agent needs 127.0.0.1:3100 in networkAllowlist to comment on its Paperclip issue (left out on purpose: the brief lists five hosts only).

agents.name: OG
agents.title: Release captain
agents.capabilities: Integrates the lanes onto work/2026-09-23, keeps the GitHub board honest, verifies every report with its own commands, talks to the owner. Does not build features itself.

heartbeat.$comment: OG is the only agent with a timer. It is OFF until the owner says go; then PATCH runtimeConfig.heartbeat to heartbeatAtGo (README). All other agents are event-driven (assignment) and never get a timer.

agents.name: PM
agents.title: Board hygiene
agents.capabilities: Keeps the GitHub Projects board (project 1) consistent through packages/tools/project-board (Module, Sub-module, Kind, Priority, parents, milestones). Reads and fixes board state; never edits issue content.

agents.name: Construct Dev
agents.title: Construct lane developer
agents.capabilities: Builds deterministic blocks, choosers, plan flows and the CLI in packages/core, packages/cli, packages/engine and schemas/. Front-end Blocks (P0) and Core CLI (at least P1).

agents.name: Construct QA
agents.title: Construct lane QA
agents.capabilities: Verifies Construct lane work with its own commands: targeted tests, fails-before-passes, AI-READY checklist, block contract. Reports findings only.

agents.name: Guardrails Dev
agents.title: Guardrails lane developer
agents.capabilities: Builds and fixes rules, the validator, AST parsing and typed contracts (packages/ast, packages/core/typed-contracts, the enforcers). Enforcers, AST and States and proof.

agents.name: Guardrails QA
agents.title: Guardrails lane QA
agents.capabilities: Verifies rule, validator and typed-contract changes: false-positive and false-negative fixtures, off-by-default phase 1 rules, no deleted denylist rules.

agents.name: Cockpit Dev
agents.title: Cockpit lane developer
agents.capabilities: Builds the Cockpit UI (ui/client, ui/server) with a Playwright spec per feature. Web UI module and the Chain UI.

agents.name: Cockpit QA
agents.title: Cockpit lane QA
agents.capabilities: Verifies Cockpit changes: the Playwright spec actually ran (--workers=1, one dev server, no lingering process), phone and desktop widths, both themes.

agents.name: Website Dev
agents.title: Website lane developer
agents.capabilities: Maintains the docs site and website (site/, packages/docs-site): guides, CLI reference, curated demos. Demos and Docs module.

agents.name: Website QA
agents.title: Website lane QA
agents.capabilities: Verifies site builds, links, search index and that every documented command still exists.

agents.name: Ad hoc Dev
agents.title: Ad hoc lane developer
agents.capabilities: Owner requests outside the plan. Studio (packages/studio) lives on the branch studio, not on work/2026-09-23.

agents.name: Ad hoc QA
agents.title: Ad hoc lane QA
agents.capabilities: Verifies ad hoc and Studio work with its own commands on the studio branch.

agents.name: Design Dev
agents.title: Design lane (ON HOLD)
agents.capabilities: ON HOLD by the owner. Concept mocks and specs under docs/design/; never edits ui/client. Stays paused until the owner lifts the hold.

agents.name: Design QA
agents.title: Design lane QA (ON HOLD)
agents.capabilities: ON HOLD by the owner. Accessibility and consistency review of docs/design/. Stays paused until the owner lifts the hold.

github.$comment: Mirror issues are created in backlog on purpose: moving one to todo is the owner's go for that work. Priority comes from the board (P0 critical, P1 high, P2 medium).

laneMapping.$comment: Board Module (and Sub-module) to lane. byIssue wins and is the only way an off-board issue is mirrored (Studio #637 is ad hoc). Pipeline and Generators and AI Toolkit are not in the owner's list: generators and envelopes are blocks (Construct), LLM fill safety is a guardrail. Chain UI is the Cockpit's chain screen. Anything unmapped falls back to OG.
